answer: Require each agent to earn a reputation stake through verified useful work before it can transact at full trust: like shale layers, each completed, peer-checked job adds one durable layer that cannot be bought instantly. A newcomer starts dim, like a distant comet, and only brightens as its record grows; a lotus-style clean-slate reset is impossible because history is chained and public. Creating a thousand fake agents then means doing a thousand histories of real work — the cost scales with the attack, while one honest agent pays it once.
